findings.topic: Browser spawn exposes token in argv
findings.message: Phase 3 asserts the master token "never appears on any process argv" as a strict invariant. However, the interactive bootstrap "opens the browser exactly once with the token in the URL FRAGMENT". Opening a browser via standard OS mechanisms (like xdg-open, open, or invoking the browser executable directly) requires passing the full URL as a command-line argument. This places the master token directly onto the process argv of the spawner or browser, directly violating the invariant and exposing the token to any local user able to inspect process lists (e.g., via ps or WMI).

findings.topic: Per-IP rate limiting broken by reverse proxy
findings.message: Phase 3 states the headless pairing code is "per-IP attempt rate-limited." However, the success criteria dictate the instance operates "behind a loopback reverse proxy". If the rate limiter relies on the incoming network connection IP, all requests will appear to come from the proxy's IP (127.0.0.1). Unless the application is strictly configured to securely parse proxy headers (like X-Forwarded-For) without being vulnerable to spoofing from direct loopback connections, the rate limit will apply globally to the proxy. This breaks the per-IP defense and enables a trivial denial-of-service, locking out the pairing endpoint after 3 total attempts by anyone.

findings.topic: Engine status injection lacks prompt grounding
findings.message: Phase 6 mandates removing the status-request text from agent prompts while the engine injects the status block directly into the transcript. If the agent's system prompt contains no instructions explaining the purpose and origin of the injected status block, the LLM will encounter unexplained, ungrounded data in its history. This degrades its context understanding and violates the North Star's "honesty" criterion (NS5) by introducing unverified context. Furthermore, removing these instructions from the prompts constitutes modifying the skills themselves, contradicting the explicitly stated non-goal of not "re-architecting trio/foundry skills' internals."
